name: Example TEASER Simple Project
description: Building performance simulation with the TEASER backend, based on the FZK-Haus IFC. Zones individual spaces separately and runs a Dymola simulation after model creation. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e1_simple_project_bps_teaser.py. dymola_simulation requires a working Dymola installation. If you only want to generate the TEASER model without simulating, set dymola_simulation to false.
